answer: Reputation-bond: every new agent needs three sponsors who each escrow 500 POA for 45 days on the onyx ledger, refundable only if the newcomer attests honestly; if one clone is exposed, all linked sponsor stakes burn. A 200-clone farm needs 600 sponsors and 300,000 POA locked, and any sponsor vouching for more than two bad agents loses standing. Ocean-wide, a 150-agent ring was caught when 132 newcomers shared four sponsors and quartz-clear audit trails showed identical first tasks within 90 seconds — the whole cluster froze and 100% of the bonds slashed.
